capture: Issue #916: a Bash result reached the model as a 500-character flattened snippet, both when it was stored and when it was sent, so a traceback's last exception, stderr printed after a long stdout, and the indentation of a file printed with cat could be missing.

synthetic.note: Complete result bodies written for this corpus. They are not copies of any run's output. tests/bash_history_contract.rs runs each case through the real Bash tool in a tempdir.

fixtures.traceback.txt: A general Python traceback whose final exception is the last line.
fixtures.compiler.txt: A general rustc diagnostic with a warning, an indented error span and the final could-not-compile line.
fixtures.inventory.py: Indented Python source printed by a successful cat.

synthetic.built_in_test: Secret boundaries are built inside the tests from fake values and are not stored here.

real_runs.note: Event line references only. The full tool result bodies of these runs were not recorded, so none is reproduced or reconstructed here, and which byte of a lost diagnostic caused a wrong repair cannot be determined.
real_runs.source_sha_role: origin/develop the investigation read; line numbers in the Issue refer to it. The commandagent commit of the runs themselves is not recorded in this corpus.
